The mirrored fixed stone is an ordinary obstruction. Native route/LOS/dash/landing/return proof must include it.

scenery.principles: Broad filled dark mineral strata; muted pale slab faces, sparse branching crystal, still off-floor water, distant island and faint reflection. Shared real warning/fill and grounded source remain strongest.
scenery.module_policy: Optional future consumer only. Omit whole repeats at courts 21/-3 to avoid crowding adjacent arrangements; actual geometry/occlusion must be reviewed after import. Do not transform a built fixed-placement module.
scenery.raised_terrain_policy: All raised shelves/spines/crystal full native extents remain outside permanent floor abs(X)<=7, with proposed minimum abs(X)>7.3. Flat interior bedding stays <= Y 0.014, has no collider and must not mask cue/feet pixels.

shore_witnesses.status: proposed optional quiet placement; no new cast asset
shore_witnesses.support: Static off-floor dry visual bank at the figures' actual native sole pivots; no walkable platform, collider, HP, interaction or clock.
shore_witnesses.viewing_policy: Voluntary view from the broad west shoulder; no required visit or input. Native crop/feet/depth/occlusion review still required.

irontick_earthrid.status: proposed parent-specific quiet placement; current 14x22 preview is not a translated drop-in
irontick_earthrid.support: Separate static off-floor dry visual bank for Earthrid; whole quiet water/rim/figure bounds outside the permanent floor. No target, damage, collider, cue or pulse clock.
irontick_earthrid.viewing_policy: Optional quiet dry-east-shoulder view. Do not require swimming, crossing water or an off-floor dash; current native camera must prove the later composition or dressing must move/omit.

scenery.water_policy: All water mesh coverage is beyond the floor's side/end border; reflective floor treatment remains dry, filled and foot-readable. No visual water hole overlays the continuous required route.

scheduler_policy: One actual fixed-profile encounter spans the level. Retain actual owners/leases/cooldowns/history across entries; end_encounter only at real aggregate cleanup. Echo exchanges remain exclusive; no ring/Echo overlap or fabricated target order.

topology_and_history.constructor_topology: A table of seven enemy recipes and one mechanism recipe is not living earned topology. Future recipients are explicitly uninstalled until actual entitlement. A paused fresh constructor may materialize only validated saved recipients.
topology_and_history.actual_attempt: Record genuine earned spatial entry, accepted native cycles, actual primary hit/death receipts and actual contact. Earlier living pursuers/retained dead native owners remain truthful; do not erase their history on departure.
topology_and_history.saved_authority: Full parent needs published supported idle/ready, same-owner and late terminal lifecycle plus whole Hero/source/Scheduler/mechanism/route validation. No proposed generation or empty placeholder Playback is a saved entitlement.
topology_and_history.camera: Use actual native source/route/footprint/cue/Hero/landing/return corners and current fixed-angle camera. Candidate math/layout extents grant no current fit, visibility, witness or contact authority.

contact_exit.required: All six genuinely earned entries, seven genuine defeats, environmental controller in its earned terminal state, no retained threat/pending damage, then actual shared capsule contact once.
contact_exit.quiet_policy: Stop further admissions through truthful terminal state; silence is not a timer or hidden final strike. Contact stays distinct from combat taps.

equipment_and_rewards.policy: Reuse the existing carried canonical 9 clothing/4 weapon types already recorded for L3. Ordinary primary and shared dash suffice; no blast, pickup or supply grant required.
